headline: GPT-5.6 Sol achieves 14x speed boost with new ultrafast processing mode
body: Cerebras and OpenAI have released an accelerated version of GPT-5.6 Sol that delivers up to 14x faster inference speeds through a new ultrafast mode. This performance jump matters for healthcare AI because clinical workflows demand real-time responsiveness: faster LLM inference directly reduces latency in documentation assistance, differential diagnosis support, and EHR integration tasks. Healthcare organizations running AI-assisted clinical decision support will see material improvements in user adoption and throughput without architectural changes. Vendors building AI layers on top of foundation models now have a more efficient path to deployment in time-sensitive care settings.
